history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: no source found for a distinct 'Pakhang Laiseng Temple' in Kakching separate from the Ibudhou Pakhangba Laishang inside the Kakching Garden (seq 2442b). 'Laiseng'/'Laishang' is the Meitei word for a god's house (temple/shrine), and Pakhangba is the same primordial Meitei deity worshipped at that garden shrine and at other Pakhangba sites (Kangla, Uyal Cheirao Ching). The most likely reading is that this CSV row duplicates the Kakching Garden shrine of 2442b, possibly from a separate source listing that named the shrine differently. Because it cannot be independently confirmed, it is recorded here as a thin placeholder pending review: either merge with 2442b or keep as a separate record if Mahesh's review finds a distinct shrine. name: Pakhang Laiseng Temple, Kakching
town_description: Kakching is a market town in Kakching district of Manipur, about 44 km south of Imphal. It is known for the Kakching Garden tourist centre at Uyok Ching on the hill south of the town market, which houses several religious shrines including the Pakhangba shrine (seq 2442b), along with parks, a rose garden and restaurants, drawing visitors from across Manipur.
